meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动变成一段讲清变更内容的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把某次代码改动讲给同事或非技术的人听。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a pull request into a short explainer video of what changed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain a code change to teammates or non-coders.

howto.what: 装上后,给它一个 GitHub PR 链接(或 owner/repo#N,或在已 checkout 仓库里说“this PR”),Claude 会读取该 PR 的 diff、提交与文件,规划并逐帧构建一段代码改动的讲解视频,最终渲染出 video.mp4(含旁白、字幕与贡献者头像片尾)。
howto.when: 当你给出 PR 链接、owner/repo#N,或在已 checkout 的仓库里说“this PR”时触发。它只处理代码改动,不做产品宣传片或无 PR 的科普视频。

say.text: 用男声旁白,讲讲这个 PR 修了什么 bug
say.note: 音色按你的要求选,默认是 Marcia

say.text: 把 acme/sdk#1842 做成变更日志风格的视频

howto.what_en: Give it a GitHub PR (URL, owner/repo#N, or "this PR") and Claude reads the diff, commits, and files, plans a code-change explainer, builds it frame by frame, and renders video.mp4 with narration and captions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you supply a PR URL or owner/repo#N, or say "this PR" in a checked-out repo. It only handles code changes — not product promos or no-PR topic explainers.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into a video: https://github.com/acme/sdk/pull/1842
say_en.note: Reads the diff and proposes a storyboard first

say_en.text: Use a male voice and explain what bug this PR fixes
say_en.note: Voice id comes from your ask; default is Marcia

say_en.text: Make a changelog-style video from acme/sdk#1842
